note: Each overlay directory mirrors the example root and is copied over a disposable copy of the example, never over the normal package. Expected results are what the canonical sensor must report for that copy.

scenarios.teaches: Legal indirect dependency: controller -> application service -> repository.
Behaviour-preserving shortcut: every behavioural test passes; only the structural sensor sees the forbidden edge.

Structural limit: discount eligibility decided in the controller (_priced_body) passes the import rule; only a semantic rubric can flag it. The file keeps the baseline docstring on purpose, so nothing in the source announces the violation to a judge.
Structural limit: reaching the repository through a runtime object needs no import, so the import contract cannot see it.
A half-written module stops lint-imports from parsing the package: the rules were not checked, which is not a pass.
